fullPassage: It was the first carnival for the four-year-old girl, Cassie. She had only heard about it from her mother. She had been imagining colorful balloons and delicious candies for a long time. When she finally arrived at the carnival, the twinkling lights and music made her jump with joy. The magician showed his tricks and she cheered with her family. But suddenly, she saw a lot of huge balloons in the parade coming towards her. She thought they were too big, like monsters. Her heart began to beat fast from fear. Cassie froze and dropped her cotton candy on the ground. She quickly hid behind her mother.

questions.passage: It was the first carnival for the four-year-old girl, Cassie. She had only heard about it from her mother. She had been (A)[imagining / forgetting] colorful balloons and delicious candies for a long time. When she finally arrived at the carnival, the twinkling lights and music made her jump with (B)[joy / sorrow]. The magician showed his tricks and she (C)[cheered / wept] with her family.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① imagining — joy — cheered: 원문 일치
❌ ② forgetting(잊으며): imagining의 반의어
❌ ③ sorrow(슬픔): joy의 반의어
❌ ④ wept(울었다): cheered의 반의어

det.korean: ④ approached(다가갔다)는 원문에 없는 내용. 원문에서 Cassie는 숨기만 했지 다가가지 않았다.

det.tip: 원문에 없는 행동 추가 주의: hid(숨음) ≠ approached(다가감)
